title: proof-carrying-data manifest (adata.uns['proof_carrying'])
description: Declares, per confound class, the minimal auxiliary variable the dataset retains, so a verifier can refuse an un-certifiable test. See docs/theory/verification_completeness_theorem.md.

unit_col.description: obs column with donor/subject/unit id (class U)

batch_col.description: obs column with processing-run/batch indicator (class B)

selection_col.description: obs column recording the selection/ascertainment mechanism (recruitment, admission, QC-retention) (class S)

co_selected.description: True iff it passed through the SAME selection channel as the claimed outcome (the relevance condition; an independent control cannot certify).

s_certifiable.description: Is a selection-collider certificate DEFINED for this dataset? (a co-selected NCO is retained)
